name: es-foral-income-tax
description: Compute 2026 resident personal income tax in Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa and Navarra for ordinary employees and sole traders. Covers the competent administration, employment and business net income, general and savings baskets, pension reductions, complete tax scales, personal and family credits, home and ordinary charitable relief, joint assessment, foreign-tax credit and annual settlement. Use for IRPF foral, renta Navarra, Hacienda Foral, EPSV, general quota, savings quota, family deductions and the distinction between withholding administration and final residence taxation. The four systems have different bases and relief rules. Check the actual territory, income category, family facts, elections and carryforwards before applying a table.
